parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-06 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 609.8 | 18.27 | 18.27
2 | 213.6 | 1.05 | 19.32
3 | 1311.8 | 4.54 | 23.86
4 | 278.0 | 3.10 | 26.96
5 | 1124.7 | 1.46 | 28.42
6 | 291.6 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-06
Curve type: HKHK type
Aquifer depth: 28.42 m to greater depth (layer 6, resistivity 291.6 Ω·m, base undetermined)
Recommendation: The low-to-moderate resistivity layer beginning at 28.42 m likely represents the main water-bearing (saturated/fractured) formation; drill to at least 35–40 m to adequately penetrate this zone, with casing set through the overlying higher-resistivity layers (0–28.42 m) to prevent borehole collapse and cross-contamination.
